**What's missing?**
A clear description of the gap or use case.

**Proposed approach**
How you'd expect it to work, if you have a preference.

**Note:** this template intentionally stays small — see CONTRIBUTING.md. Forking and
adding project-specific features locally is often the better fit for feature ideas that
aren't broadly useful to every fork.
